subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel all-explicitly-mentioned-bots reply contract, or split this into memory-plugin/channel-plugin API work plus focused Feishu fixes?
rationale: The request changes memory authority, persisted storage shape, workspace-file precedence, conflict resolution, and channel delivery semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and explicit multi-bot mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split narrower fixes
options.body: Track Feishu self-mention, app-scoped identity, and group context attribution through focused issues while opening a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want that direction.

options.title: Require plugin proof first
options.body: Ask for a plugin or memory-plugin prototype and add core API surface only where current hooks cannot express the durable rule workflow safely.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and explicit multi-bot mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current sampled history across memory docs, Feishu mention paths, and central files touched by this design surface.
